This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of M/S. M.A.AHAMMAD SAHEER, SURESH JOSEPH,
E.A.HARIS, MUHAMMED YASIL, Advocates for the petitioner and of the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.
 GOPINATH P., J  -------------------------------------
 Crl.M.A.No. 2 of 2023  In  Crl.A No.134 of 2023  -------------------------------------
 Dated this the 19th day of October, 2023  ORDER Njanadas vs State Of Kerala on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102838850/
1
The petitioner/appellant has been convicted under Sections 376(1) and 376(2)(j) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(a) and 3(b) r/w Section 4 of the POCSO Act.

He has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a period of 20 years and fine of Rs.2,00,000/-.
2.

Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant and the learned Public Prosecutor and having regard to the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant that the petitioner/appellant may be granted interim bail so as to be able to fix the marriage of his daughter aged 23 years, I am of the view that the petitioner can be granted interim bail for a period of two weeks, though, it is submitted by the learned Public Prosecutor that the Police have reported that enquiries show that no such alliance is in the offing.

In 3. The petitioner therefore shall therefore be released on interim bail till 03-11-2023 subject to the following conditions:
i.

The petitioner shall appear before the Station House Officer, Changanassery Police Station on 25-10-2023 and on 31-10-2023 between 10 A.M. and 11 A.M; iii. The petitioner shall not contact or threaten the victim; iv.

The petitioner shall not commit any offences while on bail;
v.

The petitioner shall report back to the Superintendent, Poojappura Central Prison,
by 5.00 p.m on 03-11-2023.
No application for extension of interim bail will be considered Sd/-

opennyai_summary.decision:
Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High Court be pleased to grant interim bail to the appellant for a period of 30 days, pending disposal of the above appeal in the interest of justice.
The petitioner/appellant has been convicted under Sections 376(1) and 376(2)(j) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(a) and 3(b) r/w Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
In 3. The petitioner therefore shall therefore be released on interim bail till 03-11-2023 subject to the following conditions:
i.
The petitioner shall execute bond for Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the Jurisdictional Court;
ii.
The petitioner shall appear before the Station House Officer, Changanassery Police Station on 25-10-2023 and on 31-10-2023 between 10 A.M. and 11 A.M; iii. The petitioner shall not contact or threaten the victim; iv.
The petitioner shall not commit any offences while on bail;
v.
The petitioner shall report back to the Superintendent, Poojappura Central Prison,
by 5.00 p.m on 03-11-2023.
No application for extension of interim bail will be considered Sd/-
